title: Sheafification is bijective on final point sections
statement:
Let K be algebraically closed and e : X ≅ Spec K. Let A be a concrete category with pro-etale sheafification, sheaf composition with its forgetful functor, and preservation of sheafification by that forgetful functor, as in the attached declaration. For every A-valued presheaf G, the sheafification unit G → G^a is bijective on sections over id_X.
Definitions and coefficient conventions: [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

proof.text: For injectivity, apply identity containment to the covering equalizer sieve of two sections with equal sheafifications. For surjectivity, apply it to the covering image sieve of a section of the sheafification. In both cases the local witness lies at the identity itself.
